storyCards.headline: Keep Your Hands To Yourself: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
The Georgia Satellites's "Keep Your Hands To Yourself" reached #2 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #2 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.

Keep Your Hands To Yourself was released in 1986.

"Keep Your Hands To Yourself" by The Georgia Satellites.

Chart story — peaked at #2 on the Hot 100.
